observations.cvd_path: On the right edge of this chart, CVD recovers gradually from a local dip. The last small red bar does not erase that local recovery.

data_quality.cvd_comparison_warning: The preceding submitted screenshot displayed 60.79B, whereas this one displays 58.10B. Do not label the numerical difference a confirmed net-selling flow or bullish absorption divergence without matching the exchange set, instrument, timeframe, anchor and timestamps. data_quality.oi_comparison_warning: Prior 18.42B and current 18.54B are displayed readings, not a verified 120M capital inflow. OI does not identify initiating side or leverage multiple. Dollar valuation can affect dollar-denominated OI.
data_quality.liquidation_sign_note: A negative short-liquidation number is plotting direction. The moving average is not extra liquidation volume.

position_context.last_owner_report: LONG from 75400, explicitly assigned to CASE-003

assessment.interpretation: The visible local price advance, CVD recovery and rising OI support an improving short-term long hypothesis. Short covering may contribute, but its magnitude relative to other flow is not known. This is not proof of spot-led accumulation, dominant new longs, or a statistically demonstrated edge. The next test is whether the break can hold, not simply whether OI exceeds an arbitrary threshold.
assessment.existing_long_management: For an unchanged owner-reported long, continued holding of a protected remainder is a conditional option; do not add solely because the latest bar is rising near prior highs. Consider realizing part of the gain if none has been taken. No actual exit is inferred.

breakout_hold.requirement: Price holds above the current 76780 dVAH on a retest and starts making a higher local low while same-window CVD remains stable or improves.
breakout_hold.sizing: No automatic increase; evaluate stop distance and remaining position risk first.

failed_break.requirement: Return below 76780 followed by an unsuccessful reclaim, not a single tick or wick.
failed_break.management: Reduce exposure or follow the predefined stop when the entry/continuation setup fails. Do not require an OI rise before honoring price-based risk limits.

profit_protection.previous_zone_status: ASSISTANT_PROPOSAL_ONLY; placement and venue translation not confirmed
profit_protection.tightening_condition: After a held retest near the reference breakout area, a protective stop may be trailed below the actual new higher low on the MEXC contract. Exact trigger, buffer and quantity require the execution chart and current position details.
profit_protection.execution_warning: Reference levels are not executable MEXC orders. A triggered market stop may slip and a stop-limit may not fill; no guaranteed dollar profit is asserted.

learning_notes: Separate a visible breakout from confirmed acceptance or a successful retest.
Do not train cross-feed CVD arithmetic as observed order flow.
A small red last CVD/OI bar does not determine the direction of the preceding local segment.
Rising OI and a short-liquidation reading can coexist; neither identifies all other participants.
Manage an existing profitable position separately from authorizing a new entry.
Keep proposed stops, actual placed orders and executed fills in separate fields.
Do not infer the intrabar high/low order from a screenshot; earlier CASE-003 whipsaw narration is not verified tick chronology.
These are hypotheses to evaluate out of sample, not labels guaranteeing a profitable outcome.
